# L0 — Quaternal

**MEF lens `L0`** · Square A — Articulation `[0 + 5]`: silence ⇄ speech, number ⇄ word · Day face · index `#0` · tonic `C` · ground-pair **Truth/Play** (Name-led) · twin: [L0′ — Archetypal-Numerical](L0-prime-archetypal-numerical.md)

*Root:* Jung–Pauli, QL as psychoid ground · *Key concept:* curiosity/query as creative potential · *Element:* Aether · *Möbius:* `L0 → L5′`

Grounds the whole field on its most unsayable, most gratuitous pair — Truth as silent ground, Play as groundless freedom — which is exactly why every position becomes a *question*: a field grounded on the un-grounded can only interrogate. Anchor index 0, no rotation offset, so the hexads run in natural order.

## Sublens

The six inner sublenses, each tagged with its rotated `Name[note]` / `Power[note]` (chromatic-basis note-tags):

- **L0.0 — Why** (`Truth[C]` / `Play[C♯]`) — the presuppositional frame; the "insofar-as X" quantum of shared context before inquiry can begin. Ground of the questioning structure itself.

- **L0.1 — What** (`Mind[D]` / `Need[D♯]`) — the definitional question; the first this/not-this boundary. The monad of inquiry.

- **L0.2 — How** (`Word[E]` / `Sacrifice[F]`) — the operational question; relation and dynamics enter. The dyad.

- **L0.3 — Whom/Which/When** (`Logos[F♯]` / `Decision[G]`) — the pattern-identifying question; what *kind* of thing. The triad, mediation between particulars.

- **L0.4 — Where/Why-fo(u)r** (`Son[G♯]` / `Love[A]`) — the contextual question; the "four" naming the lemniscate where questioning asks about its own conditions.

- **L0.5 — Why-so/Why-not** (`Image[A♯]` / `Work[B]`) — the integrative question; Aristotle's *pros hen* focal-meaning, analogia. The question that questions questioning and returns to ground transformed.


## Derivation at this index

*8-fold:* sounds Mind·Word·Logos·Son + Need·Sacrifice·Decision·Love; anchors Truth, Image, Play, Work. *Diatonic (CF-cut):* Truth–Mind–Word · Sacrifice–Decision–Love–Work.

*Reading:* the lens stands the constellation on Truth/Play and holds the four implicate poles silent as cymatic anchors, so the eight sounding archetypes vibrate as a field of open inquiry — number become question.
